name: Textarea
blurb: A multi-line text field that grows with what you type.
mechanism: field-sizing: content grows the box in CSS. The inline oninput is the fallback for engines that do not have it yet.
caveats: A character counter needs to be announced (aria-live) if it is the only warning before the limit.
support: `field-sizing: content` — Baseline 2026, newly available since June 2026.
The inline `oninput` fallback covers every engine older than that.
